articles.title: GHSA: RMCP: Unauthenticated permanent session-table leak in rmcp Streamable HTTP server transport leads to remote denial-of-service
articles.summary:
### Summary

An unauthenticated remote attacker can leak one entry per HTTP request out of the in-memory session table of `LocalSessionManager` by sending a well-formed JSON-RPC `POST` that is *not* an `InitializeRequest`. The Streamable HTTP server's `handle_post` allocates the session **before** it validates the body, then early-returns on the validation failure without calling `close_session`.
